archivedDataNotice: Representative launch vehicle cost and orbital payload envelopes based on NASA Launch Services Program (LSP) & VADR open reference figures.

rockets.name: Small Launcher (Electron Class)
rockets.hintText: Dedicated low-cost rocket ($8M) for lightweight satellites up to 200 kg in SSO. Cannot reach Geostationary Transfer Orbit or the Moon.
rockets.sourceLabel: Rocket Lab Electron Payload User's Guide / NASA VADR

rockets.name: Medium Launcher (Falcon 9 Class)
rockets.hintText: Workhorse medium-lift rocket ($70M) capable of sending heavy observatories to geostationary transfer orbit (GTO) or trans-lunar injection.
rockets.sourceLabel: NASA Launch Services Program (LSP) Performance Web Portal

rockets.name: Heavy Launcher (Falcon Heavy Class)
rockets.hintText: Maximum payload margin ($150M) for massive deep-space or multi-ton missions, though it consumes the entire Wildfire Watch budget on its own.
rockets.sourceLabel: NASA LSP — Heavy-Lift Launch Vehicle Capabilities

rockets.name: Rideshare Slot ($6M / 100 kg)
rockets.hintText: Most affordable way to reach LEO or SSO ($6M per 100 kg) by sharing a fairing on fixed launch dates. Cannot insert into GEO or Lunar orbit.
rockets.sourceLabel: NASA CubeSat Launch Initiative (CSLI) & VADR Rideshare
